meta.src: HiRISE 1 m DTM (Fergason et al. 2020, USGS)

method.rough_m: std. dev. of the 1 m DTM residual after a least-squares plane, per 20 m cell
method.rocks: 1 where the 95th percentile of the 1 m slope is above 30 deg; run-length [start, length, ...] over row-major cells. PROXY: boulders under ~1.5 m are not resolved
method.craters: closed depressions of the 5 m DTM (priority-flood fill), depth >= 1.0 m, equivalent diameter >= 40 m, bbox aspect <= 2.0; not the Robbins catalogue
